app.name: Shromik
app.description: Understand employment contracts against Bangladesh labour law—with verified government sources.

hero.title: Your job contract, through the eyes of the law.
hero.description: Share your contract. In minutes, see where the risks are, which clauses work in your favour, and what to ask to change. Every legal citation is checked against an official source.
hero.scope: No guesswork. No legal claims without a source.
hero.sceneAlt: A floating glass contract sheet with an emerald seal on a verified clause and a broken red glass fragment.

trust.privateOnDevice: Your name and NID stay on your device
trust.officialLink: An official link for every citation

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: From contract language to verified government sources—with clarity and privacy at every step.

comparison.title: Invented sections stop here.
comparison.description: Every citation is checked against government law. When something cannot be verified, we say so.
comparison.verifiedQuote: Where any worker in any establishment works on any day or week for more than the time fixed under this Act, the worker shall be entitled to an allowance for overtime at twice the ordinary rate of their basic wages and dearness allowance and any ad hoc or interim wages, if any.

audience.title: For everyone in the employment relationship.
audience.workersDescription: Understand contract terms and find the law that supports your rights.
audience.hrDescription: Review employment contract language and workplace policies.
audience.ngoDescription: Connect people with reliable sources in official law.

limits.title: We say what we know—and what we do not.
limits.uncertain: If something is uncertain, we say so
limits.description: This tool helps explain contracts; it does not replace a lawyer. A claim that cannot be checked against an official source is never shown as certain.

docs.title: How verification works
docs.description: ShromikAI only shows sections found in the official laws of Bangladesh. If a source cannot be matched, the finding is clearly marked uncertain.
docs.sourceDescription: Each section links directly to its relevant page in the Government of Bangladesh law repository.
docs.limitsDescription: Sample results are fictional. Understanding a real contract requires the complete document and advice from a qualified lawyer.

demo.title: Sample contract review
demo.description: This is a fictional example to show the product concept. No contract is being uploaded or stored.
demo.clause: Overtime will be paid at 1.5 times the basic wage.
demo.explanation: Section 108 sets overtime pay at twice the ordinary rate of basic wages and other applicable wages. The full calculation is not clear in this contract sentence.

review.noCitationNote: There is not enough information to verify this against an official source.

finding.dailyExcerpt: Work up to 10 hours per day.
finding.dailyExplanation: The usual daily limit is 8 hours; up to 10 hours may apply subject to the conditions in section 108.
finding.overtimeExcerpt: Overtime will be paid at 1.5 times the basic wage.
finding.overtimeExplanation: Section 108 sets overtime pay at double the ordinary rate of basic wages, dearness allowance and any applicable ad hoc or interim wages. A term listing only 1.5 times basic wages does not make the full rate clear.
finding.weeklyRestExcerpt: Rest days will be set according to the needs of the establishment.
finding.weeklyRestExplanation: This term does not specify the weekly rest day or its duration. A complete document is needed to assess it.
